scope: B15_lit_synth FULL attempt-1 audit over the ENTIRE B12 accepted ledger (outputs/B12_lit_search/attempt-1/PAPER_LEDGER.csv, rows P0001-P0062). Every count below is this run's own recount from a full read of the ledger, cross-checked against the B12 verifier's independent recounts (verification/B12_lit_search/FULL_attempt-1.md) and against the 39 records opened across the accepted pilot (8), the B12 verification (20), and this run's fresh spot-audit (14; overlaps removed). Audit date 2026-07-28.
limitations: Field definitions used for this recount: ledger_rows and accepted_core_count are direct row counts (all 62 rows carry evidence_status accepted_core). peer_review_verified_count counts rows whose B12 peer_review_status field is 'verified' (all 62); this run independently re-confirmed direct review evidence (received/revised/accepted dates, stated review model, named editor, or explicit review statement) only on the 39 opened rows, and relies on B12's verified field plus the B12 verifier's zero-materially-wrong-rows finding for the remaining 23. journal_count counts rows published in peer-reviewed journals (52 journal_article + 10 review_article per B12's typing; all 62 qualify). recent_2020_2026_count counts accepted-core rows with year 2020-2026 (my recount: hall 7, hybrid 10, hts 11, power 15 = 43, confirming the B12 verifier's corrected figure over B12's own stated 42).

correction_concern_count = 1 refers to P0012's disclosed published correction (Nat Commun 12:554, 18 Jan 2021), verified live by the B12 verifier; a correction is not a retraction and does not bar acceptance under LIT_POLICY. In this synthesis P0012 is cited only at metadata level (EV11) with no load-bearing number drawn from it.

retracted_count = 0 means no retraction or expression-of-concern notice was found on any record opened by the pilot (8), the B12 verifier (20), or this run (14), and B12 recorded none on the rest; absence of a notice on opened records is evidence of none found, not proof none exists. No second-source retraction screening (Retraction Watch/Crossref) was performed by B12, its verifier, or this run — a shared, disclosed limitation.

inaccessible_count = 0: every row has an opened publisher landing page or authoritative PMC mirror on record. P0007's full text is paywalled (open landing-page record used; disclosed, not counted inaccessible). P0037/P0040/P0041/P0042/P0043 are PMC author-manuscript or PMC mirrors of IEEE/AIP versions, as disclosed by B12; this run's open of P0043 returned a published-article PMC presentation, a minor presentational discrepancy with B12's author-manuscript label, disclosed in SOURCES.csv S10.

unresolved_count = 0: no ledger row has unresolved peer-review or correction status. Two disclosed caveats short of unresolved status: P0006's 12-day receipt-to-acceptance interval (review-depth caveat, carried from the pilot) and the two publication-type adjudications this run made (P0017 primary-not-review; P0050 review-not-primary), which affect evidence weighting only, not acceptance.

23 of 62 rows (P0011, P0014, P0015, P0019, P0023, P0025, P0026, P0027, P0029, P0035, P0036, P0042, P0044, P0047, P0052, P0053, P0054, P0055, P0058, P0059, P0060, P0061, P0062) were never content-opened by pilot, verifier, or this run; the synthesis uses them only at ledger-metadata level with per-row provenance tags in EVIDENCE_MAP.csv, and no quantitative figure is drawn from them.

duplicate_dois = [] is this run's scan of the full ledger read, consistent with the B12 verifier's manual comparison of all 62 normalized DOIs; a programmatic normalization pass was not run (this stage executes no code by contract).
Record contents were extracted via an automated WebFetch summarization layer; load-bearing numbers were quoted as returned and residual extraction-error risk is disclosed rather than denied.
